title: Bishop Carl Stanley tips the FBI about Ferrie and Martin
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Bishop Carl Stanley tips the FBI about Ferrie and Martin, about 1963 at Kentucky; New Orleans, Louisiana, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So Carl Stanley tells the FBI, "Look at these two guys in New Orleans. They're involved in the assassination."

plain: An author on occult and intelligence history, Peter Levenda, says on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that in 1963 a bishop from Kentucky named Carl Stanley went to the FBI, the US federal police. According to Levenda, Stanley told them to look at two men in New Orleans, David Ferrie and Jack Martin, saying they were involved in the assassination. If true, it would tie a little-known church figure to one of the era's darkest events.
